note: Daily-dare starters. Levels 1-6 (the jar caps at 6). Safety floor: server/content-core.js screenText. The first 8 are v0.8's, unchanged.

dares.text: Order your coffee in the voice of a movie trailer
Compliment a stranger’s shoes, and mean it
Eat lunch somewhere you’ve never sat before
Wear something inside out all afternoon
Ask a shop worker for their favourite thing in the shop
Sing the first line of a song out loud on the street
Do ten squats somewhere unusual and say nothing about it
Leave a nice note for the next person to sit where you sat
Take a different way home today, even if it’s longer
Have your chai or coffee with your phone out of sight
Write down three things you noticed on the way to work
Try a snack from a shop you’ve walked past a hundred times
Photograph something beautiful that nobody else would notice
Find out when the oldest building on your street was built
Go one whole conversation without saying “basically”
Learn the name of the person who sells you flowers, fruit or tea
Eat one meal today with your other hand
Spend ten minutes in a park doing nothing at all
Ask an elder in your family for a story you’ve never heard
Swap lunches with someone in the circle
Call a friend you haven’t spoken to in a year, just to say hi
Wear one colour from head to toe today
Thank a watchman, cleaner or conductor by name
Write the circle a two-line poem about your day
Hum the same tune all morning until someone asks what it is
Learn to say thank you in a language you don’t speak, and use it today
Send a voice note to the circle describing your lunch like a food critic
Draw a map of your neighbourhood from memory and share it
Ask someone for a place to eat nearby, and go there this week
Speak only in questions for your next conversation
Narrate the next five minutes out loud like a cricket commentator
Teach someone in the circle a skill in under five minutes
Draw the next person you sit with and give them the drawing
Ask someone to recommend a song, and listen to it with them right there
Order something you can’t pronounce, and ask how to say it
Give the next auto or cab driver a real compliment on their driving
Find three people in the circle who share your birth month, or prove none do
Bring a homemade snack to the next plan and don’t say you made it
Give a 30-second toast at your next meal with the circle
Wear sunglasses indoors for an hour, and act completely normal
Introduce yourself to a neighbour you’ve never spoken to
Speak in rhyme for the next ten minutes
Order your next meal in the local language, if it isn’t yours, after practising
Do a 20-second dance move in a park, then carry on as if nothing happened
Ask the person at the next table what they’re eating and whether it’s good
Hold a door for ten people in a row
Start a round of applause for something small and ordinary in the circle
Ask a librarian or bookseller for the best book they read this year, and borrow or buy it
Ask someone to take a photo of your circle, then offer to take one of them
Do one minute of stand-up for your circle, written today
Recite a poem out loud on a park bench
Play or sing one song in a park with a friend, just for whoever’s there
Start a conversation in a queue and learn one thing about the person
Wear a homemade paper crown for the whole afternoon
Lead your circle in a two-minute group stretch in a park
Learn a 30-second song in a language you don’t speak and sing it for the circle, outdoors
Organise a 15-minute litter pick at a spot you love, and invite passers-by to join
Ask a street musician to teach you one chord or one beat
Give a one-minute speech in a park on the best food in your city
Run a five-minute free compliment stall with a cardboard sign, in a park
